rules.name: xoga713-var-objects-verify
rules.sql: SELECT c.relname AS object_name, c.relkind AS kind, c.reltuples::bigint AS approx_rows FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname IN ('helper_var_mult_factor_view', 'helper_var_accounting_report', 'helper_var_future_view', 'helper_var_vanilla_view', 'var_bu_rule', 'var_accounting_table', 'curr_mult_table', 'var_dynamic_report', 'derivative_type_table', 'rms_premium_paid_table') ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS found, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.relname IN ('helper_var_mult_factor_view', 'helper_var_accounting_report', 'helper_var_future_view', 'helper_var_vanilla_view') AND c.relkind = 'v') OR (c.relname IN ('var_bu_rule', 'var_accounting_table', 'curr_mult_table', 'var_dynamic_report', 'derivative_type_table', 'rms_premium_paid_table') AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p'))) AS right_kind FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname IN ('helper_var_mult_factor_view', 'helper_var_accounting_report', 'helper_var_future_view', 'helper_var_vanilla_view', 'var_bu_rule', 'var_accounting_table', 'curr_mult_table', 'var_dynamic_report', 'derivative_type_table', 'rms_premium_paid_table')

SELECT orderexecuted, id, author, exectype, dateexecuted FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id IN ('create-var_bu_rule-table-v1', 'create-helper_var_future_view-view-v1', 'create-helper_var_vanilla_view-view-v1', 'create-helper_var_mult_factor_view-view-v2', 'create-helper_var_accounting_report-view-v1', 'drop-helper_var_accounting_report-table-v1', 'create-curr_mult_table-v1', 'create-var_dynamic_report-v1') ORDER BY orderexecuted

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE exectype = 'EXECUTED') AS executed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE id = 'create-helper_var_accounting_report-view-v1' AND exectype = 'EXECUTED') AS accounting_view_created FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id IN ('create-var_bu_rule-table-v1', 'create-helper_var_future_view-view-v1', 'create-helper_var_vanilla_view-view-v1', 'create-helper_var_mult_factor_view-view-v2', 'create-helper_var_accounting_report-view-v1')
SELECT locked::int AS locked FROM opera.databasechangeloglock

SELECT count(*) AS bu_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE emit_trade_group_type) AS emit_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE val_date_mode = 'global') AS global_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE val_date_mode = 'own') AS own_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE val_date_mode = 'none') AS none_rows FROM opera.var_bu_rule

SELECT (SELECT (pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) LIKE '%underlying_settle_value_table%' AND pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) LIKE '%asset_class%' AND pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) NOT LIKE '%curr_mult_table%')::int FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname = 'helper_var_mult_factor_view' AND c.relkind = 'v') AS mult_view_live, (SELECT (pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) LIKE '%helper_var_future_view%' AND pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) LIKE '%helper_var_vanilla_view%' AND pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) LIKE '%var_bu_rule%')::int FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname = 'helper_var_accounting_report' AND c.relkind = 'v') AS accounting_view_chain, (SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ',' ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = 'opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view'::regclass AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS mult_view_columns

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.var_accounting_table) AS var_accounting_table_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT upper(business_unit)) FROM opera.var_accounting_table) AS business_units_with_data, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.future_cont_series_table) AS future_cont_series_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.option_cont_series_table) AS option_cont_series_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.var_product_code_mapping_table) AS var_mapping_rows

SELECT (SELECT value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) AS cfs_value_date, count(*) AS view_rows, count(m.curr_mult) AS with_curr_mult FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view m WHERE m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) AND m.value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1)

SELECT upper(business_unit) AS business_unit, count(*) AS rows_found, min(value_date) AS first_date, max(value_date) AS last_date FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report GROUP BY upper(business_unit) ORDER BY 1

expect.reason: var_bu_rule, future view, vanilla view, multiplier view v2 and the accounting view changeSets all ran (EXECUTED)
one rule row per business unit
11 business units plus usg emit trade_group_type
10 business units use the CFS valuation date
8 business units use their own valuation date
15 business units show all value dates
the multiplier view is the live definition with the equity filter
the accounting view reads the future and vanilla views and var_bu_rule
var_accounting_table feeds the future and vanilla views; 0 means load it with rules/xoga713-var-accounting-table-load.json
the VAR product mapping (about 124 rows in legacy)
the multiplier view returns about 120 products for the CFS valuation date
the accounting view returns rows (needs var_accounting_table data)
